title: Should Students Have Homework?
text:
Many teachers give students homework every evening. Supporters say that homework helps students remember what they learned in class. It also teaches them to plan their time and work alone.

However, many parents and students disagree. They argue that long homework takes away free time for sport, family and rest. In the writer's opinion, schools should give less homework, so that students have time to enjoy their lives.

questions.text: According to supporters, what does homework help students do?
options: Remember what they learned in class

questions.text: What do parents and students say that long homework takes away?
options: Free time for sport, family and rest

questions.text: Why does the writer think schools should give less homework?
options: Teachers do not like to work
Students need time to enjoy their lives
Parents want to do the homework

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the writer's position on homework?
options: The writer strongly supports unlimited homework
The writer thinks homework should be reduced
The writer has never been a student
The writer does not care about homework

vocabulary.definition: to keep something in your mind so you can recall it later
to have a different opinion from someone else
time when you relax and do not work or study
what a person thinks or believes about something

paragraph_translations: Wielu nauczycieli zadaje uczniom pracę domową każdego wieczoru. Zwolennicy twierdzą, że praca domowa pomaga uczniom zapamiętać to, czego nauczyli się na lekcjach. Uczy ich także planować czas i pracować samodzielnie.

Jednak wielu rodziców i uczniów się z tym nie zgadza. Twierdzą, że długa praca domowa zabiera czas wolny na sport, rodzinę i odpoczynek. Zdaniem autora szkoły powinny zadawać mniej pracy domowej, aby uczniowie mieli czas cieszyć się życiem.
